text: The Axiom of Regularity (Foundation) in ZFC implies:
choices: ε-induction: to prove ∀x.P(x), it suffices to prove ∀x.(∀y∈x.P(y)) → P(x)
the power set of ω is countable
explanation: Foundation is equivalent to ∈-induction (set induction): P holds for all sets iff whenever P holds for all elements of x, it holds for x. This is the transfinite induction principle for sets.
